reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is media-input adaptation for chat sessions: it converts attachment content (especially image/video/audio) into text using configurable models and sends that into the model conversation flow, with configurable presets and fallback behavior.

summaries.zh: DSH-Multimodal 是一个面向会话场景的媒体输入处理插件，可按预设模型链把图片、音视频等附件先转为文本，再交由会话模型处理。
summaries.en: DSH-Multimodal is a conversation-focused media input plugin that preprocesses image and media attachments into text through configurable model chains before sending them to the chat model.

capabilities: Intercepts multimodal attachment inputs (image/video/audio/text) in DSH conversation send flows
Converts supported media files to text via configurable model chains before passing to the active chat model
Provides preset-based routing, model fallback, and size/type-based handling per file type
Provides configurable error behavior when conversion fails and supports pass-through fallback
Adds a dedicated Multimodal settings page for enabling and managing these behaviors in DSH

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a multimodal input plugin that processes image/video/audio/text files into prompt tokens via independent processing model chains before sending to the conversation model.
README describes a settings page with presets, per-pattern matching, prompt customization, model-chain order/fallback, and failure strategies (note/pass-through).
Architecture section explains send-path interception and attachment-button flow for immediate multimodal processing and model-call rewrite to inject converted text.
Repository description explicitly labels it as DSH 多模态输入插件并在 DSH 设置中新增独立 Multimodal 页面。
